question.text: If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> are three non-zero and non-coplanar vectors such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced open="[" close="]" separators="|"><mrow><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mo>⋅</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mo>×</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to

solution.text:
a→+3b→-c→⋅a→-b→×a→-2b→-3c→
=13-11-101-2-3a→b→c→
=13-3-3-1-2+1×4
